composition.authored_refinement: Removed the optional exposed sock bands to adopt the foremost-tights relation, clarified scarf and inner-knit boundaries, and added a visibly thick sole to both forefoot and heel in prose. Frozen original test goals were preserved.

official_render_review.technical_qualification_scope: Only the five active embodiment body-action gates; no winter visual profile opt-in gates were exposed.

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: The woman has two separately traceable gloved hands. Her actor-relative right shoulder on the image left connects through the bent cross-body arm to the upper latch hand; her other arm descends on the image right to the lower frame hand. Both boots connect to her own covered legs.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: The right upper arm bends at an elbow in front of the torso and its forearm reaches the brass latch with a coherent wrist and curled fingertips. The left elbow/forearm descends toward the lower frame grip. The latch is higher than the authored waist position, but the rendered joint chains and reach remain physically coherent.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: Both boot soles meet the broad dry center of the stone tread with grounded shadows. The slightly forward near foot and the farther foot give a stable standing base; the hips and torso remain supported over the feet while the hands apply only a small case-closing gesture.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: The upper burgundy-gloved fingertips meet the small brass latch; the lower glove curls over the metal frame ledge beside the poster. Glove, brass and frame edges remain distinguishable, and the woman has standing space next to the case. The image supports contact, without claiming measured force.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The full native frame shows the complete arm-to-hand paths around the crossed forearm, both visible hand/target interfaces, the connected covered legs and both planted boots. The display stays to her side and the human actuation is assessable. The hidden turtleneck collar is a separate failed clothing observation, not passed by this body-action gate.

selected_winter_relation_pixels.method: Local view_image with detail original; PNG pixels inspected at native 1024x1536. The view tool returned an octet-stream MIME header; it was corrected to image/png only for display, preserving all bytes.

relations.evidence: The cream scarf is a separate knitted article looping at the neck. Both fringed free ends lie over the gray coat fronts, with their own side edges and tassels visible against the felted coat panels. The wrap and tails belong to the same wearer.

Both exposed leg intervals show dense dark ribbed hosiery from the tweed skirt hem to the brown boot rims. This dark cloth is the foremost visible layer throughout those intervals; the open coat panels flank the legs and no sock band overlays the gap.

Open gray lapels and long outer panels frame the separate cream rib-knit torso. A distinct knit hem ends above the charcoal skirt waistband, and cream knit cuffs emerge at the wrists. The inner knit is visibly beneath the same woman's coat. The collar top is hidden by the scarf and is not claimed as observed.

Both boots show relatively thin dark outsole rims under the toes, while low block heels are more prominent. A broad thick sole slab does not visibly support both the forefoot and heel of either boot. The block-heel height is not proof of sole thickness, and the heel-side outsole does not provide the missing thick continuation.
unmet_elements: visibly thick sole beneath the forefoot
visibly thick sole beneath the heel
same-boot thick support slab beneath both regions

goals.evidence: Dark opaque ribbed hosiery is continuous from skirt to boots, but the original frozen condition ended at gray wool sock cuffs. Those cuffs were removed from final composition. The original endpoint condition is not fulfilled; this is not charged to generation.
No separate gray wool sock bands appear above the boot rims, matching their documented omission from the final prompt. The independent original cuff-above-rim goal was not executed.

The two chestnut-brown leather boots have continuous knee-high shafts, rounded almond toes, low block heels and visible dark outsole rims on the stone tread. This original low-heel form condition is distinct from the failed newly selected thick-sole condition.

Burgundy full-finger gloves cover both acting hands. Each wrist shows a red glove cuff beneath a cream ribbed sweater cuff emerging from the gray coat sleeve. These three successive layers remain visible even with the right forearm across the body.

The scarf has a neck loop and two separate fringed ends over the coat fronts, but its upper wrap reaches the chin and conceals any separately rising turtleneck collar top. The required separate cream collar boundary above the scarf cannot be assessed and is not a pass.
unmet_elements: turtleneck collar top visibly above scarf

goals.evidence: The coat is visibly open. Its two fronts flank the cream knit torso, charcoal pleated above-knee skirt, dark hosiery and boot rims, with connected garment boundaries and one wearer.

sealed_independent_testcase_pixels.note: All six original conditions are retained and given strict pass/fail. Two failures result from an explicitly documented agent-owned composition change, and are not counted as image-model failures. Newly selected candidate relation outcomes are separate.

unfulfilled_elements.detail: A thick outsole support slab under both forefoot and heel is not visible; ordinary low block heels and comparatively thin dark sole rims remain.
The turtleneck collar top is hidden by the upper scarf wrap; a separate boundary above the scarf is not observable.
The original gray sock-cuff endpoints and cuff-above-boot relation were deliberately removed during documented agent-owned composition; these were not executed and are not image-model failures.
No winter visual concept was exposed by the one exact pack, so winter opt-in gate activation was not tested.

whole_image_impression.impression_before_control_comparison: A calm, inviting winter threshold portrait with a believable small finishing gesture. The cream knit and scarf, gray coat, burgundy gloves and brown boots are visually distinct against blue snow and a warm cinema entrance. The face and cloth textures are detailed; the posed action feels carefully arranged but inhabits a coherent setting.
whole_image_impression.scene_readability: The poster-case latch, steadying hand, old curled sheet and empty cylinder establish a small maintenance task and its preceding work. The warm doorway plausibly offers the next place to go. The pixels support the act of closing or checking the latch; the full temporal story remains an authored interpretation.
whole_image_impression.subject_presence_and_hierarchy: The reference-guided short dark bob, wispy bangs and soft facial proportions remain visible. Face, hands and scarf lead, while skirt/hosiery/boots can be inspected second. Appearance guidance is plausible; exact identity is not established.
strengths: Two scarf tails and distinct wool/knit boundaries
Continuous opaque leg fabric between skirt and boots
Coherent human arm ownership, balance and hand-to-case contact
Warm doorway and cold stone/snow context work together
weaknesses: The adopted thick slab sole did not survive as an all-of forefoot/heel feature
The turtleneck collar top is concealed by the scarf
The latch is above the authored waist-height position; the reach remains coherent but that optional staging detail changed in pixels
